title: Multi-parent mapping reveals epistatic architecture and elite haplotypes for multi-trait improvement in cotton.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded the 46-page accepted-manuscript PDF (link.springer.com ..._reference.pdf) and read its data availability and methods sections. Queried NCBI SRA: BioProject PRJNA868192 has 327 SRA entries (matches 319 RILs, i.e. recombinant inbred lines, plus 8 founders) and PRJNA1420330 has 128. No PMCID, so no supplement listing; Europe PMC shows no supplement, no text-mined accessions, and no Zenodo/Dryad deposit.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That phenotype tables (19 traits, 2018-2019, three Xinjiang locations, two replicates) are in Additional file 2 (Tables S4-S5); 1,838,490 SNPs; 108,566 filtered SNPs for epistasis. No processed genotype matrix (VCF, a variant-call file) is said to be deposited, only raw reads plus 'genotype summary statistics'.

a1_downloadable.note: Raw reads are public in SRA, but the supplement holding phenotypes could not be retrieved (no PMC copy; the publisher page redirects to a login). I could not confirm a usable phenotype table exists as a file.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Per paper text only: trait values (fiber length, strength, lint yield, etc.) are measured columns in Tables S4-S5; not verified in files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Genotypes, the model inputs, exist only as raw whole-genome sequencing reads in SRA (327 runs). Building the SNP matrix means aligning and variant-calling raw fastq, which project rules forbid; no processed VCF is deposited.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked in files; standard fiber-quality units are implied by the paper.

a5_enough_rows.note: 319 phenotyped RILs (paper text; SRA count of 327 including founders is consistent). Below the ~400 minimum even for classification and far below 1,500 for regression; the 318 cultivars mostly lack deposited phenotypes per the text.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Raw resequencing for 327 + 128 samples, likely hundreds of GB
a6_fits_laptop.note: A processed SNP matrix would fit, but none is deposited; only raw reads are.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: SRA's 327 entries match 319 RILs + 8 founders, and 128 matches the stated new Xinjiang accessions.

a8_label_provenance.note: Traits are field measurements (two replicates, three sites), not model outputs; BLUP (best linear unbiased prediction) averages are derived from those measurements.

existing_models.name: GBLUP / Bayesian / RKHS genomic prediction on a US 550-line, 11-founder cotton MAGIC population (Heredity 2022)
existing_models.score_and_split: Search snippet: maximum prediction accuracies 0.35-0.68 across fiber traits (e.g. 0.55 fiber strength); split not checked.

backbone.name: None suitable; genotype-to-phenotype prediction in crops uses linear mixed models, not a pretrained backbone

honest_claim_h3: Predicts BLUP trait values for 319 Xinjiang-grown MAGIC lines from their SNPs, within one population and two seasons; nothing beyond that.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use each cotton line's DNA variants to predict its fiber quality and yield in the field.
plain_idea.train_on: Genome-wide DNA variants (SNPs) for each inbred cotton line; 319 lines, and the variants would first have to be called from raw reads.
plain_idea.predict: Field-measured traits such as fiber length, fiber strength and lint yield, averaged over two years and three Xinjiang sites with two replicates.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Breeders could screen lines before costly field trials, but genomic prediction in cotton MAGIC populations is already routine.

more_or_better_data.why: 319 lines versus 550 in the US 11-founder MAGIC population already used for genomic prediction.

confidence_score.why: Two replicates per line give a noise estimate, but standard mixed models already give prediction error variances.

models_beatable.why: GBLUP and Bayesian regression are the standard and hard to beat at n≈300; ML rarely improves on them in crop genomic prediction.

guaranteed_improvement.why: No processed genotypes are deposited, and the two populations differ in founders and environments, so the same-quantity, same-split conditions fail.

label_elsewhere.sources: Other cotton panels with fiber traits (US MAGIC, Heredity 2022; Chinese cultivar panels), known from search results
label_elsewhere.join_key: none standard; line names and genome-coordinate SNPs on different reference genomes
label_elsewhere.why: Field traits depend on environment, so other panels don't join cleanly as extra training data.

ml_idea: Genomic prediction of 19 agronomic traits from SNPs in 319 MAGIC RILs, transferred to 318 Xinjiang cultivars. Blocked: genotypes exist only as raw reads, and n=319.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; calling variants from raw resequencing reads for 327 samples is out of scope for a laptop.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open Additional file 2 and look for a per-line genotype matrix; there isn't one per the data availability statement.

verdict_reason: Fails A3/A5: genotypes exist only as raw SRA reads (no processed SNP matrix deposited), only 319 phenotyped lines, the phenotype supplement couldn't be retrieved, and cotton MAGIC genomic prediction is already done with standard mixed models.
